subject: Taxes
title: The Whistleblower's Price
description: A quick, practical guide to The Whistleblower's Price.

hook.text: Antoine Deltour leaked the LuxLeaks documents. He was convicted in Luxembourg and given a suspended sentence.

buildup.text: Bradley Birkenfeld exposed UBS's tax evasion scheme.

discovery.text: The journalist behind the Panama Papers, Daphne Caruana Galizia, was murdered by a car bomb in Malta in 2017.

twist.text: Whistleblowers face prison, exile, and assassination.

climax.text: Offshore secrecy is defended with more force than most crimes.

punchline.text: Expose the system, face prison or worse. The whistleblower's price.

quiz.question: What happened to the journalist behind the Panama Papers?
options: Was murdered by a car bomb
